subject: Runway alignment + QBR invite — ClearBay capacity & term uplift
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@clearbay.health>; marissa.cole@redwood.ai; karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 29 Nov 2029 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Runway alignment + QBR invite — ClearBay capacity & term uplift

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the productive check-in last week. As discussed, ClearBay is showing sustained throughput growth and we should lock a short renewal/expansion runway now so there are no surprises on capacity or billing cadence. I want to get a mutual action plan in place and schedule a QBR to confirm staffing and SLA targets before your next January push.

Proposed scope for this thread:
- Confirm desired term and the uplift cadence (one-time uplift vs staged staircase)
- Agree target burst headroom and staff ramp dates (dev + infra hours)
- Book a 60-minute QBR in the next 2 weeks to align execs + ops

Suggested QBR slots (Pacific time):
- Tue, Dec 3 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, Dec 5 — 13:00–14:00 PT
- Mon, Dec 9 — 09:00–10:00 PT

Next steps I can own: share a draft mutual action plan and a short QBR agenda for you to review (attached). Marissa from our renewals team will outline capacity options and pricing templates; Karthik will be on call for technical throughput sizing.

Attachments: ClearBay_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (Mutual action plan draft), Draft_QBR_Agenda.pdf (60-minute agenda)

Can you confirm which QBR slot works and whether procurement should be on the invite? If you prefer a different cadence for the uplift (staircase vs one-step), flag that and we’ll model both.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Account Director, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0129

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@clearbay.health>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pete Morales <pete.morales@clearbay.health>
Date: Fri, 30 Nov 2029 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Runway alignment + QBR invite — ClearBay capacity & term uplift

Evelyn —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the materials. Dec 5 at 13:00 PT looks best for our ops + engineering. Please include Pete (cc'd) from procurement — he'll confirm the PO timeline.

A couple of asks up front so your modeling team can prepare:
- We want an initial 20% uplift effective Jan 1 with the option to ramp to 50% by March if latency holds. Would like a pricing delta for the staged option vs a single-step uplift.
- Can your team outline an SLA uplift (latency and token-level SLO) for the higher tier and any cost implications for continuous KV caching at that scale?

I'll bring our head of ML infra to the QBR if needed; otherwise Pete will handle contracting.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Head of Product, ClearBay Health
jordan.lee@clearbay.health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@clearbay.health>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Nov 2029 11:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Runway alignment + QBR invite — ClearBay capacity & term uplift

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick reply and for adding Pete. Dec 5 at 13:00 PT is penciled in on our side. We’ll send a calendar invite with the QBR link and a short pre-read (mutual action plan + pricing scenarios).

To preview what we'll cover so you can share with Pete:
- Pricing scenarios: 1) One-step 50% uplift (flat uplift rate) 2) Staged: 20% Jan 1, + incremental 30% by March (discounted staircase bands).
- Capacity ops: recommended burst headroom (20–30%) and staffing pairings (CSM + Solutions Engineer + dedicated SRE hours).
- Technical annex (Karthik): expected token-level latency ranges, KV cache configuration tradeoffs, and a short runbook for graceful degradation.

Evelyn, Karthik and I will prepare a short cost/benefit table in the pre-read — Jordan/Pete, can you confirm the primary cost center (finance code) so we map the PO correctly?

Attachment: Draft_QBR_Agenda.pdf (we'll update with final attendee list)

Marissa Cole
Renewals Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0199

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@clearbay.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pete Morales <pete.morales@clearbay.health>
Date: Sun, 01 Dec 2029 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Runway alignment + QBR invite — ClearBay capacity & term uplift

All —

Confirmed: Dec 5, 13:00 PT works. Pete will own the PO; finance code is CB-OPS-231. We'll aim to have an internal decision on staircase vs one-step by the QBR, but please prepare both models.

Pete — I’ve asked you to join the QBR and look for the mutual action plan in the invite. If procurement needs any additional compliance docs (SOC2 evidence, retention policy note), call that out in advance and we’ll get them lined up.

See you Tuesday.

Jordan
Head of Product, ClearBay Health
